serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Wait, Shanice and Priestbot are here as well?
Bot: For some reason, yes.
Shanice: Haha! Playing in the water is so much fun! Come and join us!
You: Is Priestbot alright? Won’t the salt water fry his circuits?
Priestbot: I am water-resistant up to 100 meters. That’s 328 feet for you.
You: Whatever. How did you two get here?
Shanice: Haha! When we discovered that you two left the megacity for such a great place we decided to use our connections in the Church to open up a diocese here! 
Priestbot: There are many nasty rumors about this place. It’s in desperate need of our pastoral intervention. {{wi}}At least that’s what we told people at the Vatican.
Shanice: Saving the world can wait! For now, let’s play around a little!
You: Sure, have fun.
